sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Or, finding what they said could never be found.
sentences.zh: 或者，找到那些被认为永远无法被找到的东西。

sentences.en: Ambition can take you from A to anywhere.
sentences.zh: 雄心壮志可以带你从起点走向任何地方。

sentences.en: With a full tank of fuel, a quick EV charge, and snacks on the go.
sentences.zh: 加满油、快速充好电，带上零食，随时出发。

sentences.en: Ampol, Australia's own.
sentences.zh: Ampol，澳大利亚本土品牌。

sentences.en: From journalist Olivia LaVoice, the creator of the hit investigative series, The Bakersfield 3, comes the new Casefile Presents series, Ada.
sentences.zh: 继热门调查系列《贝克斯菲尔德三人组》之后，记者奥利维亚·拉沃伊斯又带来了“Casefile Presents”的全新系列节目——《艾达》。

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: The scene was unlike anything investigators had ever encountered.
sentences.zh: 现场景象是调查人员从未见过的。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally discovered her name.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于发现了她的名字。

sentences.en: But, identifying her was only the beginning.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: Through years of investigation, journalist Olivia LaVoice uncovers a life filled with unexpected discoveries.
sentences.zh: 通过多年的调查，记者奥利维亚·拉沃伊斯揭开了一个充满意外发现的人生故事。

sentences.en: The more we learn about Ada, the stranger her murder becomes.
sentences.zh: 我们对艾达了解得越多，她的死就显得越发诡异。

sentences.en: Listen to Ada, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听《艾达》。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用中本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: Today's episode deals with a crime committed against a child.
sentences.zh: 今天这集节目涉及一起针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 并非所有听众都适合收听。

sentences.en: At approximately 5pm on Tuesday, March 24, 1953, Beresford Brown rushed out of the ground floor flat at 10 Rillington Place in Notting Hill's Ladbrook Grove neighbourhood,
sentences.zh: 1953年3月24日星期二下午5点左右，贝雷斯福德·布朗冲出了位于诺丁山拉德布鲁克格罗夫街区里灵顿广场10号的底层公寓，

sentences.en: to a payphone outside.
sentences.zh: 跑向外面的一部公用电话。

sentences.en: He frantically called the police, and officers were immediately dispatched to the address.
sentences.zh: 他惊慌失措地报了警，警方随即被派往该地址。

sentences.en: Within minutes, they arrived at the three-storey residential building at the end of the cul-de-sac and raced inside.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，他们抵达了这条死胡同尽头的三层住宅楼，并冲了进去。

sentences.en: Police Constable Leslie Sizeman was one of the first to enter the ground floor flat, finding the derelict residence mostly empty.
sentences.zh: 警员莱斯利·塞兹曼是第一批进入底层公寓的人之一，发现这间破旧的住所几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: He made his way into the kitchen, a narrow, ramshackle space cluttered with junk.
sentences.zh: 他走进厨房，那是一个狭窄、破烂且堆满杂物的空间。

sentences.en: A section of wallpaper had been torn from a rear wall next to a sink to reveal a small, cupboard-like alcove hidden behind.
sentences.zh: 水槽旁后墙上的一块壁纸被撕开了，露出了后面隐藏的一个像壁橱一样的小凹室。

sentences.en: Constable Sizeman peered into the dark, confined space and recoiled in horror.
sentences.zh: 塞兹曼警员向那个阴暗狭窄的空间里望去，惊恐地退缩了。

sentences.en: The officers stripped away all of the remaining wallpaper, exposing a small, timber-framed doorway that led into a cramped,
sentences.zh: 警员们撕掉了所有剩余的壁纸，露出了一个木框小门，通向一个狭窄的、

sentences.en: brick-enclosed room measuring just four feet high and five feet six inches deep.
sentences.zh: 砖砌的房间，高仅四英尺，深五英尺六英寸。

sentences.en: There were no windows, and the flooring consisted of rubble and earth.
sentences.zh: 里面没有窗户，地面上铺满了瓦砾和泥土。

sentences.en: Tucked inside was the body of a young woman with her bare back facing the opening.
sentences.zh: 里面蜷缩着一具年轻女性的遗体，赤裸的背部对着门口。

sentences.en: She was posed in an upright, kneeling position, with her feet folded beneath her and her head and shoulders hunched forward.
sentences.zh: 她呈跪姿直立，双脚折叠在身下，头和肩膀向前弓着。

sentences.en: One attending officer later recalled,
sentences.zh: 一位在场的警员后来回忆道：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Over the years, I have seen some shocking sights, but never one so unnerving as that which greeted ourselves.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我见过一些令人震惊的场面，但从未见过像眼前这般令人毛骨悚然的景象。

sentences.en: The deceased woman in the alcove had her wrists bound in front of her with a handkerchief tied in a distinctive reef knot.
sentences.zh: 凹室里死者的手腕在身前被捆住，系着一条独特的平结手帕。

sentences.en: She was dressed in stockings and suspenders, with a black jumper, white jacket, and bra pulled up around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她穿着长筒袜和吊袜带，身上套着一件黑色套头衫和白色夹克，胸罩被拉到了脖子上。

sentences.en: The bra was fixed to a large object wrapped in a blanket that stood in front of the woman and kept her in an upright position.
sentences.zh: 胸罩固定在一个用毯子包裹的大物体上，该物体立在女子身前，支撑着她保持直立姿势。

sentences.en: The blanketed object contained another female corpse that was positioned upside down.
sentences.zh: 毯子包裹的物体里装着另一具女性尸体，呈倒置姿势。

sentences.en: Her ankles were tied together with a sock, and a stocking had been used to secure a pillowcase around her head.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝用一只袜子绑在一起，并用长筒袜将一个枕套固定在她的头上。

sentences.en: She was fully clothed, wearing a dress, petticoat, bra, cardigan, and two singlets.
sentences.zh: 她穿着整齐，身上有连衣裙、衬裙、胸罩、开衫和两件背心。

sentences.en: A singlet had also been wrapped between her legs like a nappy.
sentences.zh: 一件背心还像尿布一样裹在她的双腿之间。

sentences.en: Behind her was another blanket, this one concealing the body of a third woman.
sentences.zh: 在她身后是另一条毯子，里面藏着第三名女性的遗体。

sentences.en: Her back was resting on the ground, and her legs were stretched vertically against the rear wall.
sentences.zh: 她的背部靠在地上，双腿垂直伸向后墙。

sentences.en: She was wearing a white cotton singlet, cardigan, and makeshift nappy.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉背心、开衫和临时尿布。

sentences.en: Her ankles were tied together with wire, and her torso was smeared with ash and dirt.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝用铁丝绑在一起，躯干上涂满了灰烬和泥土。

sentences.en: The naturally cold temperature within the alcove had preserved the victim's remains,
sentences.zh: 凹室内天然的低温保存了受害者的遗体，

sentences.en: and it was determined that all three had been sexually assaulted around the time of their death.
sentences.zh: 经鉴定，这三名女性都在死亡前后遭受过性侵犯。

sentences.en: An autopsy on the woman found sitting upright at the alcove's entrance concluded she had been killed about a month earlier.
sentences.zh: 对凹室入口处坐着的女性进行的尸检显示，她大约在一个月前遇害。

sentences.en: Her cause of death was a mix of carbon monoxide poisoning and strangulation, carried out by a cord with a smooth surface.
sentences.zh: 她的死因是一氧化碳中毒和被表面光滑的绳索勒死。

sentences.en: Scratch marks on her back were consistent with her body having been dragged across the floor.
sentences.zh: 她背部的抓痕与身体在地板上被拖拽的痕迹相符。

sentences.en: The skin of the second victim was pinkish in colour, indicating she too had experienced gas poisoning.
sentences.zh: 第二名受害者的皮肤呈粉红色，表明她也经历了气体中毒。

sentences.en: She was also six months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她当时还怀有六个月的身孕。

sentences.en: The third victim appeared to have been in good health at the time of her death, though her skin also had a pinkish hue, and the nails on her hands and feet were poorly maintained.
sentences.zh: 第三名受害者在死时似乎身体健康，尽管她的皮肤也呈粉红色，手脚指甲疏于打理。

sentences.en: Toxicology reports showed that both women had consumed alcohol on the day they were murdered, which was estimated to have occurred eight to twelve weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 毒理学报告显示，两名女性在遇害当天都饮过酒，遇害时间估计在八到十二周前。

sentences.en: All three of the women were estimated to have been aged in their twenties.
sentences.zh: 这三名女性的年龄估计都在二十多岁。

sentences.en: Several loose floorboards were found in the flat's living room and were prized up, exposing a substantial pile of earth and rubble underneath.
sentences.zh: 公寓客厅里发现了几块松动的地板，撬开后露出了下面堆积的大量泥土和瓦砾。

sentences.en: The debris covered the body of a fourth female victim, wrapped in a flannel blanket with a pillowcase covering her head.
sentences.zh: 瓦砾下掩盖着第四名女性受害者的遗体，她被裹在法兰绒毯子里，头上罩着枕套。

sentences.en: She was dressed in stockings, a floral dress, and a silk nightgown.
sentences.zh: 她穿着长筒袜、碎花连衣裙和丝绸睡袍。

sentences.en: Her cause of death was determined to be strangulation with a ligature, occurring twelve to fifteen weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 她的死因被确定为十二到十五周前被勒死。

sentences.en: Unlike the women found in the alcove, this victim appeared to be middle-aged and bore no signs of sexual assault or alcohol in her system.
sentences.zh: 与凹室里的女性不同，这名受害者似乎是中年人，身上没有性侵迹象，体内也没有酒精。

sentences.en: It had been three years since the bodies of nineteen-year-old Beryl Evans and her infant daughter Geraldine were found in the backyard wash house of the same property.
sentences.zh: 三年前，十九岁的贝丽尔·埃文斯和她婴儿女儿杰拉尔丁的遗体在同一处房产的后院洗衣房被发现。

sentences.en: Both had been strangled, with Beryl's husband and Geraldine's father, Timothy Evans, ultimately held responsible for the crimes and sentenced to death.
sentences.zh: 两人都被勒死，贝丽尔的丈夫、杰拉尔丁的父亲蒂莫西·埃文斯最终被认定为罪魁祸首并被判处死刑。

sentences.en: Timothy had professed his innocence up until his execution in 1950, maintaining that his downstairs neighbour, John Christie, was his wife and daughter's actual killer.
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西在1950年被处决前一直坚称自己无罪，并坚持认为楼下的邻居约翰·克里斯蒂才是他妻子和女儿的真正凶手。

sentences.en: According to neighbours and the building's owner,
sentences.zh: 据邻居和房东称，

sentences.en: John Christie moved out of the Rillington Place ground floor flat on Saturday March 20, 1953, four days before the bodies were found inside.
sentences.zh: 约翰·克里斯蒂于1953年3月20日星期六搬出了里灵顿广场10号的底层公寓，就在尸体被发现的四天前。

sentences.en: He'd sold all of his household furniture and had arranged for a couple to sublet the flat, who arrived on the same day that Christie vacated.
sentences.zh: 他卖掉了所有的家具，并安排了一对夫妇转租这间公寓，他们在他搬走的当天就搬了进来。

sentences.en: By coincidence, the landlord visited the property that night and was dismayed to find the unfamiliar couple moving in.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，房东那天晚上去视察房产，惊讶地发现一对陌生夫妇搬了进来。

sentences.en: Christie hadn't received permission to sublet his home and the landlord ordered the couple to leave the following morning.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂并未获得转租许可，房东命令这对夫妇第二天早上搬走。

sentences.en: Once they were gone, he gave the building's top floor occupant, Beresford Brown, permission to make use of Christie's former residence.
sentences.zh: 他们走后，房东允许住在顶楼的贝雷斯福德·布朗使用克里斯蒂之前的住所。

sentences.en: Days later, Beresford was performing basic renovations in the kitchen when he uncovered the hidden alcove.
sentences.zh: 几天后，贝雷斯福德在厨房进行基础装修时发现了那个隐藏的凹室。

sentences.en: A thorough search of 10 Rillington Place resulted in the discovery of a driver's licence
sentences.zh: 对里灵顿广场10号的彻底搜查发现了一张驾照，

sentences.en: and a pile of rubbish in the rear yard, which John Christie and his wife Ethel had exclusive access to.
sentences.zh: 以及后院的一堆垃圾，约翰·克里斯蒂和他的妻子埃塞尔拥有这些垃圾的独家使用权。

sentences.en: The licence was issued to a man named Alexander Baker.
sentences.zh: 驾照的主人名叫亚历山大·贝克。

sentences.en: Police tracked Alexander down, only to learn that his girlfriend,
sentences.zh: 警方追踪到了亚历山大，却得知他的女友，

sentences.en: 27-year-old Hectorina McLennan, had been missing for some time.
sentences.zh: 27岁的赫克托琳娜·麦克伦南已经失踪了一段时间。

sentences.en: Originally from the Scottish city of Glasgow,
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜来自苏格兰城市格拉斯哥，

sentences.en: Hectorina was from a large family, with four brothers and two sisters.
sentences.zh: 她出生在一个大家庭，有四个兄弟和两个姐妹。

sentences.en: In 1948, the McLennans relocated to London, settling in the inner western area of Kensington.
sentences.zh: 1948年，麦克伦南一家搬到了伦敦，定居在肯辛顿的内西部地区。

sentences.en: Hectorina's father described her as a happy girl who was content to spend most evenings at home with her parents, even as a young adult.
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜的父亲形容她是一个快乐的女孩，即使在成年后，也满足于大部分晚上待在家里陪伴父母。

sentences.en: At the age of 23, she became a single mother to a baby girl.
sentences.zh: 23岁时，她成为了一名带着女婴的单身母亲。

sentences.en: By 1951, she had married a member of the Burmese Air Force who was stationed in the city of Portsmouth on England's south coaSt.
sentences.zh: 到1951年，她嫁给了一名驻扎在英格兰南海岸朴茨茅斯市的缅甸空军成员。

sentences.en: The couple had a daughter together, but their relationship was cut short when Hectorina's husband had to return to Burma.
sentences.zh: 两人育有一女，但随着赫克托琳娜的丈夫必须返回缅甸，他们的关系也随之结束。

sentences.en: In November 1952, her parents returned to Scotland and took Hectorina's daughters with them.
sentences.zh: 1952年11月，她的父母回到了苏格兰，并带走了赫克托琳娜的女儿们。

sentences.en: Farewelling her children was particularly hard for Hectorina, though she continued to build a life for herself in London,
sentences.zh: 与孩子们告别对赫克托琳娜来说非常痛苦，但她仍在伦敦继续经营自己的生活，

sentences.en: where she eventually commenced a relationship with Alexander Baker.
sentences.zh: 在那里她最终与亚历山大·贝克开始了恋情。

sentences.en: They were eager to live together, but had difficulty finding a home due to their financial struggles.
sentences.zh: 他们渴望住在一起，但由于经济拮据，很难找到房子。

sentences.en: On March 3, 1953,
Hectorina was at a cafe when she met the balding, middle-aged John Christie, who informed her that he had a room available to lease.
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜在一家咖啡馆遇到了秃顶的中年男子约翰·克里斯蒂，他告诉她自己有一间空房可以出租。

sentences.en: That evening, Hectorina and Alexander visited 10 Rillington Place with the intention of leasing Christie's spare room.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，赫克托琳娜和亚历山大来到里灵顿广场10号，打算租下克里斯蒂的空房。

sentences.en: Upon seeing that Hectorina had a boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 看到赫克托琳娜有男朋友，

sentences.en: Christie appeared troubled, but took them into his home regardless.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂显得有些不安，但还是让他们住进了家里。

sentences.en: Inside, it was almost entirely bare, which Christie explained was because he was about to move and had already sent his furniture away.
sentences.zh: 屋内几乎空无一物，克里斯蒂解释说是因为他即将搬家，已经把家具都送走了。

sentences.en: He agreed to let the young couple stay temporarily, but wouldn't permit them to share a bed.
sentences.zh: 他同意让这对年轻情侣暂时住下，但不允许他们同床共枕。

sentences.en: He said that his wife was staying with neighbours and would be upset if she discovered an unmarried couple sleeping together in her residence.
sentences.zh: 他说他的妻子正住在邻居家，如果发现未婚情侣在她的住所同睡会很不高兴。

sentences.en: Consequently, Hectorina slept on a deck chair while Alexander burrowed Christie's bed and Christie slept sitting up on a board positioned over a bucket.
sentences.zh: 因此，赫克托琳娜睡在躺椅上，亚历山大借用了克里斯蒂的床，而克里斯蒂则坐在架在水桶上的一块木板上睡觉。

sentences.en: The couple ended up staying at Christie's flat for three nights.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣最终在克里斯蒂的公寓里住了三个晚上。

sentences.en: At 9.30am on Friday March 6,
sentences.zh: 3月6日星期五上午9点30分，

sentences.en: Christie asked them to leave and they went to seek work at the Hammersmith Labour Exchange.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂让他们离开，于是他们去哈默史密斯劳工交易所找工作。

sentences.en: Hectorina waited outside while Alexander went in.
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜在外面等，亚历山大进去办事。

sentences.en: When he returned,
sentences.zh: 当他回来时，

sentences.en: Hectorina said that John Christie had shown up and asked her to revisit his place that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜说约翰·克里斯蒂出现过，并让她那天下午再去他家一趟。

sentences.en: She planned to do so, telling Alexander she would meet him at a nearby cafe afterwards.
sentences.zh: 她打算照做，并告诉亚历山大之后会在附近的咖啡馆见他。

sentences.en: Alexander went to the cafe as instructed, but by 5pm, there was no sign of his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大按指示去了咖啡馆，但到了下午5点，仍不见女友踪影。

sentences.en: He went to 10 Rillington Place to find her, but Christie claimed that Hectorina had never arrived.
sentences.zh: 他去里灵顿广场10号找她，但克里斯蒂声称赫克托琳娜从未到过那里。

sentences.en: Alexander noticed Christie's flat had a very nasty smell, but thought little of it.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大注意到克里斯蒂的公寓有一股非常难闻的气味，但没多想。

sentences.en: Christie had offered to help him look for Hectorina and the pair had searched together until 9 o'clock that night.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂主动提出帮他寻找赫克托琳娜，两人一起搜寻到了那天晚上9点。

sentences.en: On several occasions over the next few days,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，

sentences.en: Christie turned up at the Hammersmith Labour Exchange while Alexander was there and had inquired as to whether he had found Hectorina.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂多次出现在亚历山大所在的哈默史密斯劳工交易所，询问他是否找到了赫克托琳娜。

sentences.en: Alexander didn't report Hectorina's disappearance to the police as the pair lived a rather transient lifestyle and he doubted anything serious had happened.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大没有向警方报告赫克托琳娜的失踪，因为两人过着相当漂泊的生活，他怀疑并没有发生什么严重的事情。

sentences.en: However, her unexplained disappearance did raise the concerns of Hectorina's brothers who filed a missing persons report.
sentences.zh: 然而，她莫名其妙的失踪引起了赫克托琳娜兄弟们的担忧，他们提交了一份失踪人口报告。

sentences.en: Hectorina's fingerprints were compared to those on her police file, positively identifying her as the woman found at the entrance to the alcove in John Christie's former flat.
sentences.zh: 赫克托琳娜的指纹与她警方档案中的指纹进行了比对，最终确认她就是约翰·克里斯蒂前公寓凹室入口处发现的那名女性。

sentences.en: Police also checked the fingerprints of the other two victims from the alcove against records on their database.
sentences.zh: 警方还将凹室中另外两名受害者的指纹与数据库中的记录进行了核对。

sentences.en: They ascertained that the second victim was 25-year-old Rita Nelson who was born and raised in the Northern Ireland city of BelfaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们确定第二名受害者是25岁的丽塔·尼尔森，她在北爱尔兰城市贝尔法斯特出生长大。

sentences.en: Rita had a difficult life and upon entering adulthood found herself in trouble with the police for a range of minor offences.
sentences.zh: 丽塔的生活很艰难，成年后因一系列轻微犯罪而惹上了警察。

sentences.en: At the age of 21, she spent a brief period of time in a mental health facility and gave birth to a son shortly after.
sentences.zh: 21岁时，她在精神卫生机构待过一段时间，不久后生下了一个儿子。

sentences.en: She was immensely proud of her child and was devastated when at the age of two he was taken into care.
sentences.zh: 她非常以自己的孩子为傲，当孩子两岁时被送往寄养机构，她感到万分悲痛。

sentences.en: In October 1952,
Rita and her cousin travelled to London hoping to find work, but parted ways shortly after their arrival and never saw each other again.
sentences.zh: 丽塔和她的表亲前往伦敦寻找工作，但抵达后不久就分道扬镳，再也没有见过面。

sentences.en: Rita found a room in a lodging house in the inner west neighbourhood of Shepherd's Bush where she mostly kept to herself.
sentences.zh: 丽塔在内西部街区谢泼德丛林的一家旅馆里找到了一个房间，平时大多独来独往。

sentences.en: Her mother described her as a quiet, serious-minded girl whose main outside interest was going to the pitches.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲形容她是一个安静、严肃的女孩，主要的户外兴趣是去球场看球。

sentences.en: Rita worked a variety of jobs including a hospital orderly, a waitress and a cleaner, saving her money and sending some home to her parents at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 丽塔做过各种工作，包括医院勤杂工、女服务员和清洁工，她省吃俭用，圣诞节还会寄钱回家给父母。

sentences.en: The last time they heard from her was on Friday January 16, 1953.
sentences.zh: 他们最后一次收到她的消息是在1953年1月16日星期五。

sentences.en: The exact circumstances of how Rita Nelson first met John Christie were difficult to determine.
sentences.zh: 丽塔·尼尔森最初是如何认识约翰·克里斯蒂的，具体情况很难确定。

sentences.en: She was known to frequent cheap eateries known as transport cafes and it was believed she may have encountered Christie during a visit to one.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，她经常光顾被称为“运输咖啡馆”的廉价餐馆，据信她可能是在某次光顾时遇到了克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: In the first week of January 1953,
sentences.zh: 1953年1月的第一周，

sentences.en: Rita had been offered a job at a tea shop, but her employment was thrown into jeopardy on January 12 when she discovered she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 丽塔在一家茶馆得到了一份工作，但1月12日她发现自己怀孕了，这份工作岌岌可危。

sentences.en: As she didn't have a support network in London,
sentences.zh: 由于她在伦敦没有支持网络，

sentences.en: Rita obtained a letter from a medical officer requesting that she be admitted to a home for unmarried women until the baby was born.
sentences.zh: 丽塔从一名医务官那里获得了一封信，请求将她收容进未婚女性之家，直到孩子出生。

sentences.en: The last time Rita was seen was on Wednesday January 14.
sentences.zh: 丽塔最后一次露面是在1月14日星期三。

sentences.en: Six days later, on Tuesday January 20,
sentences.zh: 六天后，即1月20日星期二，

sentences.en: Rita's landlord visited her room chasing up a late rent payment and found the letter from the medical officer.
sentences.zh: 丽塔的房东去她的房间催缴逾期房租，发现了那封医务官的信。

sentences.en: Days later, the landlord visited a police station to inform them of Rita's unexplained disappearance.
sentences.zh: 几天后，房东前往警察局，告知他们丽塔莫名失踪的情况。

sentences.en: With the discovery of the bodies at Rillington Place,
sentences.zh: 随着里灵顿广场尸体的发现，

sentences.en: Rita's sister was summoned by the police and identified the second body in the alcove as her sister.
sentences.zh: 丽塔的姐姐被警方传唤，确认凹室里的第二具尸体就是她的妹妹。

sentences.en: Using fingerprint records, the third victim was identified as 26-year-old
sentences.zh: 通过指纹记录，第三名受害者被确认为26岁的

sentences.en: Kathleen Maloney.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·马洛尼。

sentences.en: Originally from the port city of Plymouth in southwest England,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳来自英格兰西南部的港口城市普利茅斯，

sentences.en: Kathleen's parents both died in quick succession when she was two years old and she and her two older sisters were sent to live in a Catholic orphanage.
sentences.zh: 她的父母在她两岁时相继去世，她和两个姐姐被送往一家天主教孤儿院生活。

sentences.en: Their aunt and uncle visited regularly, with the latter describing Kathleen as very wild, not in a bad way, but full of pranks.
sentences.zh: 她们的姑姑和姑父经常来看望，姑父形容凯瑟琳非常顽皮，不是那种坏的顽皮，而是充满恶作剧。

sentences.en: Throughout her adolescence,
sentences.zh: 整个青春期，

sentences.en: Kathleen was transferred between various orphanages and by the age of 18, she left the system altogether.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳在不同的孤儿院之间转来转去，18岁时，她彻底离开了这个系统。

sentences.en: She worked as a cleaner and a laundress and went on to have five children, one of whom was adopted while the other four were sent to live in a children's home.
sentences.zh: 她做过清洁工和洗衣工，后来生了五个孩子，其中一个被领养，另外四个被送往儿童之家生活。

sentences.en: Kathleen lived a transient lifestyle, residing in abandoned buildings and moving about between the cities of London,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳过着漂泊的生活，住在废弃的建筑物里，在伦敦等城市之间辗转。

sentences.en: Southampton and Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 南安普顿和利物浦。

sentences.en: She turned to sex work to support herself and often fell foul of the law.
sentences.zh: 她为了维持生计开始从事性工作，并经常触犯法律。

sentences.en: By September 1952, she was spending most of her time in London's inner west and was so impoverished that she occasionally slept in public toilets.
sentences.zh: 到1952年9月，她大部分时间都待在伦敦内西区，生活极其贫困，有时甚至睡在公共厕所里。

sentences.en: In October that year, she and her friend
sentences.zh: 那年10月，她和她的朋友

sentences.en: Maureen Briggs visited a pub in the neighbourhood of Paddington.
sentences.zh: 莫琳·布里格斯（Maureen Briggs）去了一家帕丁顿附近的酒吧。

sentences.en: There, they sighted a spectacled man in his fifties standing at the bar with a raincoat over his arm.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她们看到一个五十多岁、戴着眼镜的男人站在吧台边，手臂上搭着一件雨衣。

sentences.en: Maureen described the encounter, quote,
sentences.zh: 莫琳描述了这次邂逅，引用如下：

sentences.en: He had thinnish lips and he was sort of licking his lips when he was talking.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴唇很薄，说话时总是在舔嘴唇。

sentences.en: He got talking to me.
sentences.zh: 他开始跟我搭话。

sentences.en: He asked me if I wanted to earn myself some money and I said I would.
sentences.zh: 他问我想不想赚点钱，我说想。

sentences.en: He asked me if I ever had any photographs done in the nude.
sentences.zh: 他问我有没有拍过裸照。

sentences.en: He said he did that and he knew a place where he could take me to do some.
sentences.zh: 他说他拍过，而且知道一个地方可以带我去拍一些。

sentences.en: The man introduced himself as John Christie and despite his offer to Maureen, nothing eventuated.
sentences.zh: 那个男人自称是约翰·克里斯蒂（John Christie），尽管他向莫琳提出了邀请，但后来什么也没发生。

sentences.en: In early December, the two women bumped into Christie again and agreed to accompany him to a room that had been set up as a studio.
sentences.zh: 12月初，这两个女人又碰到了克里斯蒂，并同意随他去一个被布置成摄影棚的房间。

sentences.en: Maureen lay naked on a bed while Christie took photographs of her and Kathleen watched.
sentences.zh: 莫琳赤身裸体地躺在床上，克里斯蒂给她拍照，凯瑟琳（Kathleen）在旁边看着。

sentences.en: Christie then undressed and asked Kathleen to photograph him and Maureen together.
sentences.zh: 随后克里斯蒂脱掉衣服，让凯瑟琳拍他和莫琳在一起的照片。

sentences.en: No sex was involved and Christie paid each woman a pound for the work.
sentences.zh: 过程中没有发生性行为，克里斯蒂付给每人一英镑作为报酬。

sentences.en: Some time later,
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，

sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳与一名公共厕所管理员攀谈起来，说她认识了一个名叫

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂先生的男人，她很同情他，因为他的妻子去世了。

sentences.en: She said that Christie had promised to give her some of his late wife's clothes but when she visited to collect them,
sentences.zh: 她说克里斯蒂答应给她一些他亡妻的衣服，但当她去取衣服时，

sentences.en: Christie's landlord threw her out.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的房东把她赶了出来。

sentences.en: She also told a postman that she had met a man who offered her housing in Ladbrook Grove.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉一名邮递员，她认识了一个男人，对方提出可以在拉德布鲁克格罗夫（Ladbrook Grove）为她提供住所。

sentences.en: On the evening of
sentences.zh: 在1月10日星期六的晚上，

sentences.en: Saturday January 10,
sentences.zh: 1月10日星期六，

sentences.en: Kathleen and Maureen were drinking at a pub when John Christie arrived.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和莫琳正在酒吧喝酒，这时约翰·克里斯蒂来了。

sentences.en: He bought them drinks before leaving with a heavily intoxicated Kathleen between 9 and 10pm.
sentences.zh: 他在晚上9点到10点之间带着醉醺醺的凯瑟琳离开前，请她们喝了酒。

sentences.en: John Reginald Christie was born in the northern county of Yorkshire.
sentences.zh: 约翰·雷金纳德·克里斯蒂（John Reginald Christie）出生于约克郡北部。
zh_words: 约翰·雷金纳德·克里斯蒂

sentences.en: The fourth of six children to old-fashioned parents, he was his mother's favourite but had a difficult relationship with his stern father.
sentences.zh: 他是家中六个孩子里的第四个，父母思想保守，他是母亲的最爱，但与严厉的父亲关系紧张。

sentences.en: Christie was a quiet, nervous child with few friends and his peers viewed him as odd.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂是一个安静、神经质的孩子，朋友很少，同龄人觉得他很古怪。

sentences.en: Known to friends and family as Reggie, he enlisted in the army as a teenager and served as an infantryman during the First World War.
sentences.zh: 亲友们称他为雷吉（Reggie），他十几岁时参军，在第一次世界大战期间担任步兵。

sentences.en: While fighting in France, he was injured in a gas attack and spent a month recovering in hospital.
sentences.zh: 在法国作战时，他在一次毒气袭击中受伤，在医院休养了一个月。

sentences.en: Christie later claimed that the incident left him blind for six months and unable to speak for three and a half years.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂后来声称，那次事件让他失明了六个月，并且三年半无法说话。

sentences.en: There were no medical documents to verify this, yet he was known to speak at a particularly low volume.
sentences.zh: 没有任何医疗记录可以证实这一点，但他说话的声音确实特别小。

sentences.en: After the war ended, he returned to Yorkshire and in May 1920, married Ethel Waddington.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，他回到约克郡，并于1920年5月与埃塞尔·沃丁顿（Ethel Waddington）结婚。

sentences.en: Over the following decade,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的十年里，

sentences.en: Christie committed a series of crimes, including larceny and assault, all of which resulted in brief stints in prison.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂犯下了一系列罪行，包括盗窃和袭击，所有这些都导致他短暂入狱。

sentences.en: The assault, which involved Christie striking a woman in the head with a cricket bat, was described by the trial judge as a murderous attack.
sentences.zh: 那次袭击涉及克里斯蒂用板球棒击打一名女性头部，被审判法官描述为谋杀性攻击。

sentences.en: Christie was released after serving six months hard labour, at which point he and Ethel had been separated for a decade.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂服完六个月苦役后获释，当时他和埃塞尔已经分居十年了。

sentences.en: The pair reconciled, though their relationship endured another setback when Ethel suffered a miscarriage.
sentences.zh: 两人重归于好，但他们的关系在埃塞尔流产后又遭受了挫折。

sentences.en: In 1938, they moved into
sentences.zh: 1938年，他们搬进了

sentences.en: 10 Rillington Place, residing in the top floor flat, before taking the ground floor residence at the end of that year.
sentences.zh: 里灵顿广场10号（10 Rillington Place），住在顶楼公寓，年底搬到了底层住宅。

sentences.en: Following the outbreak of World War II,
sentences.zh: 二战爆发后，

sentences.en: Christie applied to become a war reserve constable.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂申请成为战时预备役警员。

sentences.en: Overwhelmed by the influx of recruits, authorities failed to check his criminal record and accepted his application.
sentences.zh: 由于新兵涌入，当局未能核查他的犯罪记录，接受了他的申请。

sentences.en: He was assigned to the Harrow Road police station, where he took a great joy in overzealously patrolling the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 他被分配到哈罗路（Harrow Road）警察局，在那里他以过度热心地巡逻社区为乐。

sentences.en: His neighbours nicknamed him the Himmler of Rillington Place, after Heinrich Himmler, the commander of Nazi Germany's paramilitary organisation, who also looked
sentences.zh: 邻居们给他起了个绰号叫“里灵顿广场的希姆莱”，以纳粹德国准军事组织指挥官海因里希·希姆莱命名，因为他看起来也

sentences.en: somewhat like Christie.
sentences.zh: 有点像克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: At the end of 1943,
Christie resigned from the role and went to work for a transistor radio manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂辞去了职务，去了一家晶体管收音机制造商工作。

sentences.en: When the bodies were discovered in the Christie's former flat, neighbours informed police that they hadn't seen Ethel for several months.
sentences.zh: 当在克里斯蒂的前公寓发现尸体时，邻居们告诉警察，他们已经好几个月没见过埃塞尔了。

sentences.en: The last confirmed sighting of her was on December 12, 1952, when she had dropped some washing off at a laundromat in Kensington.
sentences.zh: 最后一次确认见到她是在1952年12月12日，当时她在肯辛顿的一家自助洗衣店送洗了一些衣物。

sentences.en: In the weeks that followed,
sentences.zh: 在随后的几周里，

sentences.en: John Christie had given varying stories to explain his wife's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 约翰·克里斯蒂对妻子的去向给出了不同的说法。

sentences.en: He told one neighbour that she was visiting relatives in the northern city of Sheffield, while telling another she had gone to Birmingham to care for her sister, who was recovering

sentences.en: from surgery.

sentences.en: And her family gifts every Christmas, but in the one just gone, they had received a card from her husband instead.
sentences.zh: 她的家人每年圣诞节都会收到礼物，但刚过去的那个圣诞节，他们收到的是她丈夫寄来的贺卡。
